kind: Source and format observations, synthetic unit tests and an installed-asset sweep of RBSP version 1 collision translation and retail pak names
claims: collision evidence only; no map drawn, no runtime or rendering claim

format.lumpLayout: Quake III's seventeen in the same order plus a light array at index 17 (:356-:373)

surface.difference: four lightmap numbers, x and y, plus lightmap and vertex styles

lightGridPoint.difference: four ambient and direct sets, four styles, direction

acceptance.jkaProfile: COM_GAME_BSP_JKA for version 1; every other version refused

translation.target: IBSP 46 layout for the existing collision loader
translation.sharedRecords: copied without interpretation; stored little-endian values kept on any host
translation.rewrittenRecords: the four differing records, keeping the first lightmap set
translation.checksum: taken from the installed file before translation and unchanged by it
drops: second, third and fourth lightmap sets and their styles
the light array mapping grid points to light-grid entries
draw-surface reference on every brush side
translation.rendererGate: a renderer cannot be built on this translation; it needs a reader that keeps styles and the light array; that gate stays open

bounds: header must be a full eighteen-lump directory
every lump must lie inside the file without covering the directory
each fixed-size lump's length must be a whole number of its records
indices inside records are left to the collision loader

retailPakNames.profileRule: official-pak rule is profile-owned through a pak stem; refuses base/assets0-assets8 and missionpack/assets0-assets8, leaves Quake's numbered names free

pureReferenceFlag.installationNote: multiplayer modules are pak members in assets2.pk3 and, patched, assets3.pk3; no loose copy in base/

installedSweep.invocation: --installation <path>; writes only below --output; keeps no retail payload

pakNameChecks: both modes refuse all nine assets names in base and missionpack, accept Quake's numbered names, refuse a server's base/assets3.pk3 before a download plan is made
noRetailPayload: no retail map, pak or asset is required, incorporated or shipped
openItems: renderer reader keeping lightmap styles and the light array
